verdict.rationale: Synctera is API-first: documented APIs cover the core product surface, including personal and business customers, accounts, cards, internal transfers, ACH, wires, scheduled payments, RDC, KYC/KYB verification, EDD, disclosures and webhooks, backed by a published OpenAPI spec. However, nothing states that the API matches the UI feature-for-feature. The learning-center docs also describe console-side operational workflows, such as admin-managed team access, employee case notifications and permissioned external-account linking, with no API equivalent shown. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage of console operations (user/role management, case management and notifications), and independent corroboration.
